questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Advanced NgRx Options”?
options: Advanced NgRx Options should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
Advanced NgRx Options helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
Advanced NgRx Options means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Advanced NgRx Options removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
questions.answer_key: Advanced NgRx Options helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Advanced NgRx Options is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

options: Connect “NgRx Signal Store” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
Treat “NgRx Signal Store” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
Assume “NgRx Signal Store” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.

questions.answer_key: Connect “NgRx Signal Store” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “NgRx Signal Store” under Advanced NgRx Options. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Advanced NgRx Options”?
options: Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
